title: Past Simple
description: We use Past Simple for completed actions in the past.
examples: She worked in Dubai last year.
They went to the market yesterday.
grammar_rules: Use did for questions, didn't for negatives
negative_form: I didn't go to work yesterday.
tips: Time words like 'yesterday' and 'last week' signal Past Simple.
Watch out for irregular verbs like go → went, eat → ate.
